title: cf CLI commands stop working after update with unknown command errors for camelCase names like getCredits
symptoms: cf accounts billing getCredits fails with an unknown command error
Scripts or agent prompts using camelCase cf subcommands break after npm install --global cf@latest
Flags that worked in an earlier beta are rejected
cause: Cloudflare CLI 1.0.0-beta.16 renamed generated command names to kebab-case, for example getCredits became get-credits, and also made other breaking command and flag changes.
fix: Update scripts to the kebab-case command names and check the CLI release notes for renamed flags, or pin the older beta version in CI until you migrate.
